headline: Senate racks up a legislative scoreboard with major sanctions, spending, and judicial confirmations in Friday blitz!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate passed H.R. 5334, the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, 86-11, imposing tough new sanctions on Russia and Iran in honor of the late Senator Graham. Lawmakers also cleared H.R. 6500, a continuing appropriations bill for fiscal 2027, by a 90-6 vote, averting a government shutdown. On personnel, the Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as Attorney General plus a slate of 44 nominees across multiple federal agencies in a single vote.
